svg.title: Pic dels Pessons o Gargantillar — illustrated terrain, view from 30 degrees
svg.desc: Terrain: Mapzen; Europe terrain produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union — EU-DEM layers; SRTM/GMTED2010 courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey. Stylised orthographic terrain with adjusted vertical scale; not a route map. No inferred snow or trails.
